# SupaSidebar

> A macOS sidebar app that works with any browser - Safari (including Safari Technology Preview), Chrome, Firefox, LibreWolf, Edge, Arc, Brave (including Brave Origin), Vivaldi, DuckDuckGo, Norton Private Browser, and 25+ more. SupaSidebar gives you Spaces, Pinned Links, Live Tabs, a Command Panel, Smart Folders, and Air Traffic Control routing, with iCloud sync across Macs.

## Getting started

- [Installation and setup](https://docs.supasidebar.com/gettingStarted): Install and configure SupaSidebar on macOS 14+
- [Permissions](https://docs.supasidebar.com/gettingStarted/permissions): Permission Status in Preferences, with per-browser Automation and Accessibility checks and links to System Settings
- [Browser Support](https://docs.supasidebar.com/gettingStarted/browserSupport): All 25+ supported browsers and their integration levels (Basic, Live Tabs, Profile Spaces)
- [Languages](https://docs.supasidebar.com/gettingStarted/languages): Supported localization languages

## Features

- [Sidebar Panel](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/sidebar): The floating sidebar interface, multi-screen support, left/right positioning, drag-to-resize, custom per-link colors, adjustable text size, notes on links. Expanded-sidebar selection includes saved links, Recent pages, Live Tabs, and folder contents; copy URLs or create a folder, then finish with Done or Escape. Includes the Bring Browser to Front on Show toggle, Auto-Switch Side on Clipped Browser, and the When Sidebar Opens / When Sidebar Hides menus that control browser layout on show and hide
- [Folder Browser](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/folderBrowser): Finder-style column popover for saved folders, single-click open, Quick Look, Open With, Move to Trash, hover preview (with an Off option to require an explicit click), and Finder actions on file-type links
- [Spaces](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/spaces): Workspace organization with per-space group-by, collapse/expand all folders, the space options menu, and mouse-wheel or trackpad-swipe space switching. Compact centered icons enlarge on hover for easier navigation
- [Browser Profiles](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/profileSpaces): Link a browser profile or whole browser to a space for session isolation
- [Link Open Tabs to Space](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/linkOpenTabs): Per-space tab memory that closes tabs on leave and reopens them in the original browser and profile on return, with lockable tabs that persist everywhere
- [Pinned Links](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/pinnedItems): Up to 12 pin slots with `Cmd Opt 1-9` and `Cmd Opt 0`, custom shortcuts for slots 11 and 12, and optional numpad shortcuts
- [Link Notes](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/linkNotes): Attach a note of up to 200 characters to any saved link, shown as an icon on the link and matched by Command Panel search
- [Recent Links](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/recentItems): Recent activity plus local imports of the last 30 days from supported browsers, including visits while SupaSidebar was closed. Browser-specific imports, privacy pauses, and clearing preserve saved links
- [Air Traffic Control](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/airTrafficControl): URL-pattern rules that auto-route saved links into the right space (and optional folder), and open links in the right browser. Includes smart history-based suggestions and a one-click rule prompt from the Command Panel
- [Power-ups](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/powerUps): Per-link superpowers including Auto-update Link for episodic content and Open Next episode
- [Smart Folders](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/smartFolders): Rule-based folders that auto-organize by URL, tag, or date
- [Tags](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/tags): Organize and filter saved links with tags, with AI tag suggestions from OpenAI, on-device MLX models, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible server
- [Trash](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/trash): Deleted links move to the Trash where you can restore them, delete them permanently, or empty it, with a configurable 7 to 90 day retention window before they are auto-removed
- [Command Panel](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/commandPanel): Find live tabs, pinned pages, saved links, recent visits, and Settings in labeled groups. A Recommended section brings together up to five strongest matches without guaranteeing a result from every source. Reopen within 60 seconds to resume the query, scope, selection, and scroll position. An index progress bar shows local search updates. Browse website scopes from the scope bar or / picker, keep your query when switching sites, see where results will open, and use ranked Open With choices and expandable web suggestions.
- [Search Shortcuts](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/commandPanel/searchShortcuts): Select a website icon or type / and part of a website name or keyword, then Space or Return. Browse matching open, saved, and recent pages or search the website. Clearing the query keeps the website selected. Add and reorder custom shortcuts in Preferences.
- [Ask AI](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/askAI): Natural-language AI assistant inside the Command Panel
- [Sidebar Access](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/sidebarAccess): Floating button, mouse triggers, and dock mode
- [Live Tabs](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/liveTabs): Real-time bird's-eye view of every open tab across every browser on your Mac (Safari + Safari Technology Preview, Chrome, Firefox, LibreWolf, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, DuckDuckGo, Orion, Helium, Dia, and 20+ more), with per-URL custom colors, view-mode switch (compact / detailed), right-click Open With to copy any tab to a different browser or profile, Move to Browser to move a tab and close the original, and `Cmd Opt Click` to replace the active tab on saved links and pinned tabs. Multiple browser windows have separate collapsible headers with session-only custom names
- [Bulk Closing Tabs](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/liveTabs/bulkClose): Right-click a live tab to close other tabs in its window, browser, or all browsers, or every tab above or below it
- [Browser Integration](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/browserIntegration): Sidebar layout (Attached or Independent) plus separate "When Sidebar Opens" (do nothing / prevent overlap / fill the freed space) and "When Sidebar Hides" (restore the browser / expand to fill / leave it) menus. Fill works in both Attached and Independent layouts. Smart Attach waits at the screen edge for an eligible browser; Appearance > Motion offers Tighter, Tight (default), Balanced, and Loose following. Auto-tile, Auto-Switch Side on Clipped Browser, profile-aware targeting
- [Link Preview](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/linkPreview): Mini preview window for saved links; a Tooltip Delay switch in Preferences turns hover previews on or off, with an Instant / 1 / 2.5 / 5 sec delay dropdown
- [Shortcuts](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/shortcuts): Complete keyboard shortcut reference
- [Privacy & Browsers](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/privacyBlocklist): Separate per-browser Live Tabs, Recents, and History controls; Private Mode pauses recording while keeping Live Tabs. Blocking hides tabs and imported history but keeps older Recents until cleared. Clear imported history or history and unsaved Recents without deleting saved links or browser-owned history
- [Incognito Mode](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/incognitoMode): Pause Recents, history imports, search history, and ranking signals for all browsers. Live Tabs keep working. Private-window detection is not guaranteed; enable SupaSidebar privacy controls before browsing privately
- [MCP](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/mcp): Model Context Protocol integration for AI assistants
- [iCloud Sync](https://docs.supasidebar.com/features/sync): Multi-device sync via iCloud across all your Macs

## How to

- [Save links](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/savingLinks): Every method for saving links and adding notes
- [Open links](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/openingLinks): Open saved links, set Preferred App per saved file or folder, or set Preferred Browser per saved website.
- [Browser selection](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/browserSelection): Choose a browser or profile once with Open With, or set Preferred Browser on a saved link. An explicit per-link preference overrides ATC routing.
- [Drag and drop](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/dragAndDrop): Add files and folders from Finder
- [Browser import](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/browserImport): Import bookmarks from Arc, Chrome, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi, Firefox, Safari, or an HTML file. Chromium and Firefox imports support a profile picker so each browser profile becomes its own SupaSidebar space. Arc imports preview the chosen sidebar data file and let you select which Spaces to import
- [Export & Import Data](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/exportImportData): Export spaces as .ssb backups, plain JSON, or browser bookmark HTML. In 1.1.0, .ssb backups can include app settings, keyboard shortcuts, search shortcuts, and ATC rules. Restoring settings is opt-in.
- [Smart Save and Smart Copy](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/smart): Context-aware shortcuts that adapt to the frontmost app
- [Claim discount](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/claimDiscount): Apply discounts at checkout
- [Search settings](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/searchSettings): Find preferences by name, jump to a matching section, or change supported toggles directly from search results.
- [Send feedback](https://docs.supasidebar.com/howTo/sendFeedback): Send feedback from Preferences with an editable reply email; failed submissions keep your message in the form.

## Troubleshooting

- [Sidebar stays on top](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/sidebarStaysOnTop): Fix the sidebar always staying above other windows
- [Sidebar doesn't hide in browser](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/sidebarDoesntHideInBrowser): Fix auto-hide not triggering when a browser is focused
- [Sidebar appears automatically](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/sidebarAutoAppears): Turn off Auto-show with Browser when the sidebar pops up on its own every time you open a browser
- [Sidebar appears in the wrong browser](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/sidebarAppearsInWrongBrowser): Check Blocking beside a browser in Preferences > Privacy & Browsers so the sidebar stops auto-showing and attaching there
- [Prevent Overlap isn't working](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/preventOverlapNotWorking): Fix Prevent Overlap by checking Smart mode, Accessibility permission, and conflicting window apps like HazeOver
- [Link opens new tab instead of switching](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/linkOpensNewTab): Fix Smart Tab Reuse not activating the existing tab
- [Duplicate tabs in Live Tabs and your browser](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/duplicateTabs): Stop seeing the same tabs in both Live Tabs and your browser by choosing one surface as your hub
- [Reset permissions](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/permissions): Reset a stuck Accessibility or Automation permission with tccutil when shortcuts stop capturing your URL
- [License issues](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/license): Free a device slot or move your license to a new Mac from the web-only Manage License page
- [Browser Profiles troubleshooting](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/profileSpaces): Fix missing profiles, wrong browser launches, and Live Tabs showing the wrong profile's tabs
- [Missing browser profiles](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/browserProfilesMissing): Diagnose whether a missing Chrome, Brave, or Edge profile is a browser-side or SupaSidebar-side issue
- [MCP issues](https://docs.supasidebar.com/troubleshooting/mcp): Common Model Context Protocol problems and fixes
